reader_summary.overview: Episode 33: Overture (with the Internet History Podcast!) Ben & David dive deep into the early days of internet search. We are huge fans of IHP at Acquired, so this was a real treat to collaborate with Brian and the great work he does over there. In this episode we cover the story of how a small incubator in Southern California spawned perhaps the greatest tech business model of all-time.
